title: Alembic interface contract deep optimization independent demand sequence
purpose: Continue the accepted cross-repository interface contract work into deeper legacy-interface logic rewrites across all related demands and product repositories.
philosophy: Each item is an independent demand definition. Order is dependency order. D8-D14 refine and execute old-interface rewrite work after D0-D7, without replacing D7 final acceptance or reducing existing behavior.
preClaimGate: Do not claim D8-D14 as a bypass for an open D7 blocker.
Preferred path: complete or explicitly block D7 with controller evidence, then claim D8.
If D7 still has a blocker that belongs to the same legacy rewrite chain, carry it into D8/D11 as a named input while preserving D7 evidence and stop rules.
globalUserDecisions: This is deep optimization for all alembic-interface-contract related demands, not only D0 inventory.
Rewrite old interface logic according to the new demand/contract model across all related repositories.
Preserve full functionality; this is not feature reduction.
Do not accept thin minimum implementations, placeholder adapters, docs-only shells, static mocks, narrow demos, or happy-path-only evidence.
Delete old interfaces, fields, endpoints, events, adapters, or compatibility paths only after no-consumer proof, replacement evidence, and representative validation.
Use clean, tool-specific and function-specific contracts rather than global field bags that expose unrelated values.
Keep version/evolution strategy deferred unless the user explicitly reopens it.
Product repository changes are owned by the product windows; controller owns sequence routing, review, acceptance, and archival evidence.
claimRules: Claim at most one demand at a time.
Do not dispatch from this manifest alone; create a state root for the claimed demand first.
Read D0-D7 accepted evidence, the D1 registry/ADR, and this manifest before claiming a product demand.
D8 must produce the second-stage execution matrix before D9-D13 product rewrite work.
D9 Core convergence should run before product demands that rely on shared deterministic contracts.
D10 Agent rewrite should run before Alembic Agent-consumer cleanup when those paths overlap.
D11 Alembic provider/runtime rewrite should run before Plugin and Dashboard consumer rewrites that replay Alembic fixtures.
D12 and D13 may run after D11 evidence is accepted, unless D8 marks a narrower independent slice.
D14 runs only after D8-D13 are accepted, blocked with explicit controller decision, or marked not applicable with evidence.

items.title: Deep Optimization Control Plane
items.goal: Turn the accepted D0-D7 contract work into a concrete second-stage execution matrix for deep legacy-interface refactoring across all five product repositories.
items.completionDefinition: Every remaining old interface logic candidate is mapped to owner, old entrypoint, replacement contract, consumer, validation path, deletion condition, and risk; already solved candidates are closed with evidence; D9-D13 demand inputs and D14 acceptance criteria are claimable; this is not inventory-only or docs-only work.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Build the second-stage execution matrix for all remaining old interface logic across the five repositories.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Use D0-D7 evidence and current code scans to produce product-window rewrite inputs for D9-D13 and final acceptance inputs for D14.

items.title: AlembicCore Legacy Contract Convergence
items.goal: Converge remaining Core-owned shared deterministic contract logic onto the D2 contract spine and remove or quarantine duplicated legacy definitions that consumers no longer need.
items.completionDefinition: Core public exports, schemas, validators, and fixtures cover real shared deterministic consumers; private/deep imports and copied schemas are removed or blocked with evidence; Core does not absorb product runtime responsibilities; consumer validation proves preserved behavior.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Rewrite remaining Core-owned old shared contract logic onto the D2 public spine and prove consumer import boundaries.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Update only Core-owned deterministic contracts, remove eligible duplicates, and return Core plus consumer-boundary evidence.

items.title: AlembicAgent Runtime Legacy Rewrite
items.goal: Rewrite remaining Agent tool/runtime/provider legacy interface logic onto the D5 public contract model.
items.completionDefinition: Agent manifests, router inputs, execution envelopes, result envelopes, provider-adapter outputs, and host-adapter seams cover every public result branch with fixtures/tests and do not leak provider-private or hidden reasoning fields; existing Agent capabilities remain reachable.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Rewrite remaining Agent old runtime/tool/provider interface logic and prove all result branches.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Update only Agent-owned runtime/tool/provider contracts, add branch fixtures/tests, and return Alembic consumer impact notes.

items.title: Alembic Runtime And Provider Legacy Rewrite
items.goal: Rewrite remaining Alembic CLI, daemon, HTTP, runtime-control, job, event, and Agent-consumer legacy interface logic onto the accepted provider contract model.
items.completionDefinition: Alembic provider/runtime paths use explicit checked contracts, command semantics, problem responses, event/job schemas, and Agent result handling; open D7 runtime blockers are repaired or precisely classified; Plugin and Dashboard fixture compatibility is preserved.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Rewrite remaining Alembic old provider/runtime/Agent-consumer logic and fix open runtime smoke blockers.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Update only Alembic-owned provider/runtime/consumer code, preserve explicit runtime-action semantics, and return real route/runtime evidence.

items.title: AlembicPlugin MCP And Host Legacy Rewrite
items.goal: Rewrite remaining Plugin MCP, host-adapter, clean-output, resident-service, and Codex-local legacy interface logic onto tool-specific contracts and accepted Alembic provider fixtures.
items.completionDefinition: Every active MCP tool has tool-specific schemas, projector, error/problem shape, fixture/golden coverage, resident/host replay evidence, and representative real MCP sampling where feasible; generic field bags and unrelated refs are removed or blocked with evidence.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Rewrite remaining Plugin old MCP/host/resident interface logic onto per-tool clean contracts.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Update only Plugin-owned MCP/host/resident contracts, prove per-tool outputs, and return real MCP/output examples.

items.title: AlembicDashboard Consumer Legacy Rewrite
items.goal: Rewrite remaining Dashboard API client, event consumer, socket, and view-model legacy interface logic onto accepted Alembic provider fixtures and explicit capability discovery.
items.completionDefinition: Dashboard consumes checked provider fixtures, keeps view models presentation-only, preserves loading/empty/error/partial/unavailable/permission/stale states, removes eligible old DTO normalizers, and validates affected user-visible workflows.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Rewrite remaining Dashboard old consumer/view-model logic onto provider fixtures and explicit capability discovery.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Update only Dashboard consumer/view-model contracts, preserve UI states, and return fixture/state evidence.

items.title: Cross-Repo Legacy Removal And Deep Acceptance
items.goal: Accept the D8-D13 deep optimization sequence by proving old interface logic was rewritten, eligible duplicates were removed, preserved functionality still works, and remaining compatibility is explicitly justified.
items.completionDefinition: Every D8 candidate is closed, rewritten, intentionally kept, or blocked with raw evidence; deletions have no-consumer proof and validation; cross-repo checks cover Core, Agent, Alembic, Plugin, and Dashboard success and non-success paths; no thin/docs-only/mock closure is accepted.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Review D8-D13 raw evidence, prove legacy convergence/removal, and route remaining blockers.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Build final review pack, pull raw evidence, run final drift/runtime/MCP/consumer checks, and decide acceptance or rework.
